title: Exact weighted neighborhood statistics, opaque unweighted plans and remaining pixel kernels

entry_inventory.interpretation: Names only; bounded parameter/context semantics, not complete GEE compatibility

implementation.expanded_existing_entry: Image.reduceNeighborhood: 12 actual scalar statistics, minMax and shared-input combine/setOutputs
implementation.weights: Positive kernel/mask/min weights over binary source validity; weighted sum retains coefficient scale, mean/population dispersion normalize actual valid weights; count/min/max ignore positive magnitude. Sample dispersion/product/median/default mode require uniform effective weights converted to unit support per operation.
implementation.unweighted: Opaque validated single-input plan accepted only in neighborhood. No implicit regional/list/array/reducer-composition/public-JSON/truthiness use.
implementation.numeric: Exact dyadic products and moments Q*W-S^2, rational nearest-even Float64 rounding. Standard deviation uses bounded integer sqrt and exact midpoint comparison, no floating seed or ULP walk.
implementation.grid: Full source bounds and common-grid proof before merging bands; Float64 before temporal selection; explicit clip retained, output ROI/resampling downstream; observed keys/time preserved.
local_policies: Binary mask validity only; fractional source masks unsupported
Missing/masked neighbors omitted; skipMasked=false fills only existing center tiles
Zero valid support returns NoData including count; sample n<2 returns NoData; smallest tied mode; input signed zeros canonicalized to +0
Distance kernel fractional extent uses ceil(radius) full square; no Google footprint parity
Signed normalization and meter kernels reject
limits: Canonical spec32768 ASCII bytes;33x33/1089 cells;offsets within32;positive radius smaller than tile dimensions
Native100000 keys/100M decoded cells/10M per tile/1e8 per-tile work/1e9 total work unchanged
rejected: Nonuniform weights for sample dispersion/product/median/mode unless mask/unweighted
Multi-input reducer descriptors, repeat/group, unsupported leaves even when dropped
Optimization strategies and nondefault mode histogram parameters
Unbound constant images, array-valued images, unproven grids, final Float64 overflow

validation.actual_process_evaluator: Pinned openEO registry/evaluator metadata tests cover focal/convolve/neighborhood single-band selection, input extent and output reprojection/ROI. No fabricated pixels.
